description:
Fantom Corporation is a mission-focused organization supporting critical programs across the defense and intelligence community. We partner with our customers to deliver high-impact technical solutions while fostering a culture built on trust, expertise, and long-term career growth.
We are seeking a Platform Engineer to design, implement, and maintain the infrastructure that powers enterprise applications and services. This role focuses on building secure, scalable, and highly available platform solutions using modern cloud-native technologies, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and DevSecOps best practices.
The ideal candidate has strong experience with container orchestration, automation, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure, along with a passion for improving platform reliability, security, and operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

 Design, deploy, and maintain enterprise platform infrastructure supporting mission-critical applications and services

 Build, manage, and optimize Kubernetes clusters and containerized application environments

 Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform to automate infrastructure provisioning and management

 Develop and maintain configuration management solutions using Ansible and Puppet

 Administer and support Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) environments

 Deploy, manage, and maintain Kubernetes applications using Helm

 Design, implement, and optimize CI/CD pipelines to support automated application delivery

 Implement DevSecOps best practices by integrating security throughout the software development and deployment lifecycle

 Manage AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) policies, roles, and permissions to ensure secure access to cloud resources

 Monitor platform performance, availability, and security while identifying opportunities for optimization and automation

 Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, container, and deployment issues across development and production environments

 Collaborate with software developers, security engineers, and operations teams to deliver scalable and reliable platform solutions

 Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance platform performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency


Required Qualifications

 Must be fully cleared with a recent polygraph 

 Must be willing and able to work fully onsite at the location listed in this posting 

 Experience designing and supporting Kubernetes-based infrastructure

 Strong knowledge of DevSecOps principles and secure software delivery practices

 Hands-on experience with Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC)

 Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible and Puppet

 Strong administration experience with Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL)

 Experience deploying and managing applications using Helm

 Experience with container management technologies and containerized application deployments

 Experience designing, implementing, and supporting CI/CD pipelines

 Experience managing AWS IAM roles, policies, and security controls

 Strong troubleshooting, automation, and infrastructure optimization skills

 Excellent communication and collaboration skills within cross-functional engineering teams


Desired Qualification
 
 Kubernetes certifications such as Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)

 AWS certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer

 DevSecOps or Infrastructure Automation certifications

 Experience supporting large-scale cloud environments

 Experience working with highly available, enterprise-grade production systems

 Familiarity with cloud security, compliance, and infrastructure monitoring best practices

 #CJ

 
Fantom Corp is a Software Development, Agile Cloud, Software Development, Cyber Security (Risk Management, Assessments & Authorization (A&A)), Data, AI Platform (Computer Vision Models), Podcasting Media Services, and IT Services provider. Established in 2015, Fantom Corp serves Federal customers with top-notch Cybersecurity Architects, Data Scientists/Analysts, Software Engineers/Developers, DevSecOps Engineers, Project Managers, Identity, Credential Access Management (ICAM) services , and Cloud-certified practitioners. We excel in delivering emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) with a focus on identifying trends, object detection, and classification of structured and unstructured data. Fantom Corp possesses mastery in all aspects of digital audio production. We lead in the ideation and creation of efforts for clients who want to harness the power of podcasting. We guide them in selecting the right show format for their needs and goals. As a Small Business, we possess the innovation, speed and flexibility to meet your requirements.
